title: Helm chart: `certController.startupProbe.port` / `useReadinessProbePort` removed
remediation: If the release set either value, drop it; the cert-controller startup probe now always uses the readiness port. Helm ignores the old keys.
verifyCommand: helm list -A -o json | jq -r '.[] | select(.chart | startswith("external-secrets-")) | "\(.namespace)/\(.name) \(.chart)"'  # each row is an ESO Helm release; run helm get values on it
